scoring_justification: The Eliashberg functions are raw curves from which peak positions can be recomputed directly, enabling a full T1 recompute against paper-reported energies and physical trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold peak positions and trend constraints for the normal and pairing Eliashberg functions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.2 and text: low-energy peak ~0.04J (≈5 meV), broad peak ~0.34J (≈40 meV) at antinode δ=0.15; doping evolution, momentum dependence, and temperature persistence described in Sec. III.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's quantitative statements and energy scales (J=120 meV). Tolerances chosen to absorb plausible implementation spread while excluding trivial guesses.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly traceable to the paper's reported quantitative results and the required physical trends; no arbitrary labels or invented holdout data are used.

outputs.description: Raw Eliashberg function curves; the checker will recompute peak positions from this data and compare them against the paper-reported gold values.
Agent-reported peak positions; the checker will compare these against its own recomputed peaks and the hidden paper reference values.

output_contract.notes: The Eliashberg functions must be computed for the following conditions (condition strings as examples): AN_delta0.06_T0.002J, AN_delta0.09_T0.002J, AN_delta0.12_T0.002J, AN_delta0.15_T0.002J, AN_delta0.09_T0.06J, HS_delta0.15_T0.002J, ND_delta0.15_T0.002J. The hot spot and node positions are defined on the Fermi surface as per the paper. Parameters: t=2.5J, t'=0.3t, J=120 meV. All calculations start from the t-J model formulas in Ref. [50]; no external datasets are provided.

steps.description: Recompute peak positions from raw Eliashberg functions and verify absolute positions and physical trends.

trends.doping_shift_AN: for conditions AN_delta0.06_T0.002J, AN_delta0.09_T0.002J, AN_delta0.12_T0.002J, AN_delta0.15_T0.002J: the broad peak positions (both channels) must be monotonically increasing with doping
trends.momentum_AN_to_HS: the low-peak amplitude (max alpha2F_n in low window) must decrease from AN_delta0.15_T0.002J to HS_delta0.15_T0.002J, and at HS both alpha2F_n and alpha2F_p must be < 0.01
trends.pairing_at_node_zero: for ND_delta0.15_T0.002J, max absolute value of alpha2F_p over the whole energy range must be < 1e-6
trends.temperature_persistence: for AN_delta0.09_T0.06J, low and broad peaks must still be detected in the normal channel, and their amplitudes must be lower than the corresponding amplitudes in AN_delta0.09_T0.002J

steps.description: Check that the agent‑reported peak positions are consistent with those recomputed from the raw Eliashberg functions (CSV).
